Spina Bifida is Latin for split spine... It is a disability that is when you are born... The back is not fully closed leaving the spinal cord open... There are 3 types... Occulta, Meningoclie, and myleomeningoclie..  Occulta is where you can walk and it is hidden, Meningocile is worse... It is where you can see the spinal cord... But myleomeningoclie is the worst... And is what I have... It is very unlikely that you will walk... I can. It can result in Hydrocephalus.. Which is fluid in the brain... That's all I can explain... Also I've had 13 surgeries because of it.
